title: Display game results for all markets

requirements.text: Add a backend function to store and retrieve declared game results per market, including open number, close number, and jodi values with a timestamp.

quotes: Aur abhi games ke result bhi dikhao

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes a query to fetch recent game results for all markets
Each result record includes market ID, open number, close number, jodi, and declaration timestamp
Results are stored persistently in actor state

requirements.text: Display the latest declared game results for each market on the Market Lobby page. Each market card should show the most recent open number, close number, and jodi result beneath the market name and schedule.

quotes: Aur abhi games ke result bhi dikhao

acceptanceCriteria: Each market card in MarketLobby shows the latest result (open | jodi | close) if available
If no result has been declared yet for a market, a 'Result Awaited' placeholder is shown
Results are fetched from the backend and update automatically (polling consistent with markets query)

requirements.text: Add a dedicated 'Results' section or page accessible from the main navigation that lists all markets with their historical game results in reverse chronological order (date, market name, open number, close number, jodi).

quotes: Aur abhi games ke result bhi dikhao

acceptanceCriteria: A Results page or section is accessible from the app navigation
Results are listed per market in reverse chronological order
Each row shows date, market name, open number, close number, and jodi
Page is accessible to unauthenticated users

requirements.text: Add a React Query hook (e.g. useGameResultsQueries) to fetch all declared game results from the backend actor, with a 30-second polling interval consistent with the markets query.
acceptanceCriteria: Hook fetches game results from the backend actor
Hook returns results grouped or filterable by market

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
Keep all Motoko logic in backend/main.mo single actor
Minimum deposit must remain 20 Rs as previously set
Game times must remain 10 hours shifted back as previously set
nonGoals: Re-implementing the result declaration admin form (already exists in ResultDeclarationForm component)
Changing bet placement or payout logic
